## Answers

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` (S3 presigned-URL refresher) — every 12 h (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:30`; ticker loop `Run` at `:32`, work at `RunOnce`/`CheckAndPresign` `:43`/`:47`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed and run once at `server/server.go:162-163`, then the periodic goroutine at `server/server.go:166-171` (called from `Server.Start`, `server/server.go:128`). It re-presigns S3 object references whose `LastPresignedTime` is older than 4 days (5-day expiry) and writes the new URL back via `Store.UpdateAttachment`.

**h02.** Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (executes `safeClient.Do(req)` at `:152`); enqueued asynchronously by `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`) onto a 128-slot channel drained by 4 goroutines (`:38`, `:42-56`).
Protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`) installed as the `http.Transport.DialContext` of `safeClient` (`:31-39`), which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`) against `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, 169.254.0.0/16 IMDS, IPv6 equivalents — `validate.go:14-24`). Dial-time checking also defeats DNS rebinding. Config-time validation is `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`), called when webhooks are created/updated (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`). Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`validate.go:41`).

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — `IdentityProviderUserInfo`). Concrete implementation: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19` `IdentityProvider`, `NewIdentityProvider` `:27`, `ExchangeToken` `:47`, `UserInfo` `:83`). OAuth2/OIDC is the only protocol shipped.

**h04.** No. `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once in the repo, in the factory: `store/db/db.go:22` (inside `NewDBDriver`). A repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB|mysql.New|&mysql.DB` finds no other construction site; the only other `mysql.` references are the `go-sql-driver/mysql` DSN helpers inside `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:17,30,73` and the testcontainers `mysql` package in `store/test/containers.go:101-105`. (By contrast `sqlite.NewDB` *is* built directly in tests: `store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`.)

**h05.** By explicit Go code, inside the per-driver `DeleteUser` transaction — not by a DB rule.
- `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96` → `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (`:380`, `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE content_id IN …` for the user's memo tree) and `:102` → `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`:400`, `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE creator_id = ?`).
- Same pair in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102,380,400` and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102,417,437`.
- Checked schemas: `reaction` has no foreign keys or `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`); the only cascade in the schema is `memo_share.memo_id` (`sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06.** Handlers (all `APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `:513` → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `:119`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → side effects at `:48`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → side effects at `:48`

Convergence: all funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`) → `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), and the single function that performs delivery is **`webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`**.

**h07.**
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` (registered from `server/server.go:80-81`)
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (checks `userCache` on ID lookups) — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` (populates `userCache`) — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (SELECT incl. `avatar_url`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (peers: `store/db/postgres/user.go`, `store/db/mysql/user.go`)
- Bytes decoded from the stored data-URI by `FileServerService.parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`, MIME-allowlisted at `:201` (`avatarAllowedTypes`, `:75`) and written with `c.Blob` at `:209`

**h08.** Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? **yes** — caller: `server/server.go:163` (`startBackgroundRunners`), plus its own ticker loop `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? **no** — no caller anywhere (production or test); the only cross-package use of that package is the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`), and `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called.

**h09.** Count: **8** declarations of `Close` in the backend; 6 non-test.
- `*store.Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — called by `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*apiv1.SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — called by `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — called by `store/store.go:74,75,76` (instanceSetting/user/userSetting caches)
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67` — called via the `Driver` interface at `store/store.go:78` (the one that runs by default)
- `*postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46` — same call site, only under `--driver postgres`
- `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — same call site, only under `--driver mysql`
- Test-only, never called by server code: `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200` and `:282`.

**h10.** `(*Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — ~37 call sites repo-wide (highest of any `internal/` symbol), of which 7 are production: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:356`, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:85`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:87,98`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:78`; the rest are in `internal/filter/*_test.go`.
If you count production callers only, the top is the unexported helper `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ~28 call sites, all inside `internal/filter/render.go`; next is `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — 27 call sites (7 production, e.g. `server/auth/token.go:194`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26,135`).

**h11.** 1st: **`store.User`** — referenced from ~6 packages outside `store/` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`), ~71 references. 2nd: **`store.Memo`** — ~4 packages (`server/router/api/v1`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`), ~51 references. (Third is `store.Attachment`, 3 packages.) Types defined at `store/user.go`, `store/memo.go`.

**h12.** Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (builds and executes `INSERT INTO \`memo\` … RETURNING …` at `:41`).
Determination: the default of the `--driver` flag is `sqlite` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver","sqlite")`, `:130` flag default), and with no `--dsn` the DSN is derived as `<data>/memos_prod.db` (`internal/profile/profile.go:110-116`). `db.NewDBDriver` switches on `profile.Driver` and returns `sqlite.NewDB` for that value (`store/db/db.go:19-20`), called once at `cmd/memos/main.go:56`. The `store.Driver` interface value is stored in `Store.driver` (`store/store.go:47`), and `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109-114`) delegates straight to `s.driver.CreateMemo` — so the interface dispatch resolves to the sqlite implementation; `postgres`/`mysql` peers exist but are unreachable without the flag.

**h13.** Implementation: the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`, satisfying `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`). It is the only implementation (`internal/markdown/renderer.MarkdownRenderer`, `markdown.go:250,451`, is an internal collaborator, not a `Service`).
Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` (inside `NewAPIV1Service`); test-only second site at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.
Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`); `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, handed the same instance at `server/server.go:85`); `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, unwired), plus it is passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`runner.go:74`).

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `Service.ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` (single goldmark AST walk), writing `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers: `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (before `Store.CreateMemo`); `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field mask path is set — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`; and the bulk backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` (currently not wired into startup, see h08). `CreateMemoComment` recomputes transitively because it goes through `CreateMemo`.
Extracted: `Tags` (deduped `#tag`s) and `Mentions` (`markdown.go:376-381,418-419`), and `MemoPayload_Property` fields `Title` (text of a leading H1, `:383-389`), `HasLink` (`:394`), `HasCode` (`:397`), `HasTaskList` (`:400`), `HasIncompleteTasks` (unchecked task box, `:403`).

**h15.** Distinct enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68` (used by `GetMemo` `:356`, parent memo `:367`, `ListMemoComments` `memo_service_comments.go:148`)
- `ListMemos` query-scoping (`VisibilityList` / CEL filter by viewer) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:217-227`
- `CreateMemoComment` parent-memo check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Reaction service (`UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction`) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-38` and `:83`
- Attachment service memo-access check — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451`
- `ListMemoAttachments` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-222`
- HTTP file server `checkAttachmentPermission` (incl. share-token bypass) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650,677,699`
- SSE delivery filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143`
- User stats scoping — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90` (`ListAllUserStats`) and `:218-220` (`GetUserStats`)
- RSS feeds, public-only — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Frontend SSR/meta tags, public-only — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Email/inbox notification gating — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`, `server/notification/email.go:313-316`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67,84`

**r01.** False premise: there is no Redis anywhere in the repo (no `redis` import, dependency, or config; grep over all `.go`/`go.mod`/`.ts` finds zero hits). The cache layer is a process-local in-memory TTL map: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` `:66`, `New` `:76`, `SetWithTTL` `:98`, background `CleanupInterval` sweeper). Three instances are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — all with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5m`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:38-52`; package default also 10 min at `store/cache/cache.go:59`). User entries are set at `store/user.go:132,148,161` and invalidated explicitly on update/delete (`store/user_delete.go:38-46`).

**r02.** False premise: there is no rate-limiting middleware in this codebase — no `golang.org/x/time/rate`, no `middleware.RateLimiter`, no per-user limiter, and no limits to report. The only Echo middleware registered is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`, `server/cors.go`). The Connect/gRPC chain is metadata → logging → recovery → auth only (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138`), with a request *size* cap (`connect.WithReadMaxBytes(maxAPIRequestBytes)`, `v1.go:141`) and concurrency semaphores for thumbnail/image work (`v1.go:59-60`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:117`) — none of which are rate limits.

**r03.** False premise: there is no cron scheduler running in the server and no nightly database-cleanup job, so there is no scheduled time. `internal/scheduler` is a standalone cron library (`scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`, `middleware.go`) that nothing in production imports — the only importers are its own `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10` and `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`. The sole background work started by the server is the 12-hour S3 presign runner (`server/server.go:158-172`; see h01), which refreshes URLs rather than cleaning the database.

**r04.** False premise: neither — there is no message broker at all (no NATS, RabbitMQ/AMQP, or any broker client in `go.mod`), and no queue is declared anywhere. Webhook delivery is entirely in-process: a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:38`) drained by 4 goroutines spawned in `init()` (`:42-56`), each calling `Post` (`:120`). Producers call `PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the payload with a warning when the buffer is full (`:190-196`) — so delivery is best-effort and non-durable, lost on restart.

**r05.** False premise: there is no GraphQL schema, server, or dependency in the repo (zero `graphql` hits). The public API surface is Protobuf-defined and served three ways: Connect RPC + gRPC-Gateway REST generated from `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (schemas in `proto/gen/api/v1`, wired in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95-141`, handlers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`), plus non-RPC HTTP surfaces — the file server (`/file/...`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS feeds (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), SSE (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`), an MCP endpoint (`server/router/mcp`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:65`). An OpenAPI document is embedded at `proto/openapi_embed.go`.
